                    SOAH ORDER NO. 33
  GRANTING MR. HOWTON’S MOTION FOR LEAVE TO SUPPLEMENT
   THE EVIDENTIARY RECORD AND ADMIT ADDITIONAL EXHIBIT
                AND AMENDED EXHIBIT LIST


      Before the Administrative Law Judges (ALJs) is Jason A. Howton’s Motion
for Leave to Supplement the Evidentiary Record and Admit Additional Exhibit and
Amended Exhibit List (Interchange Item No. 6132). The ALJs have considered
Mr. Howton’s motion to supplement the evidentiary record, and for good cause
having been shown, hereby GRANT his motion for leave to supplement the record
 and admit the additional exhibit and amended exhibit list. In particular,
Mr. Howton moves for leave for the admission of:


      Applicants’ Response to Jason Howton’s Fourth Set of Requests for
      Information (PUC Interchange Item No. 6043, filed June 9, 2026) as
      Exhibit JAH-32 in this proceeding.


      The ALJs hereby ADMIT into evidence in this proceeding Applicants’
Response to Jason Howton’s Fourth Set of Requests for Information (PUC
Interchange Item No. 6043, filed June 9, 2026) as Exhibit JAH-32. Mr. Howton
may reference and cite to Exhibit JAH-32 in his post-hearing closing brief due
June 19, 2026.


Signed June 18, 2026.
